about_the_game:
Tosbik Around the World is a tiny shooter adventure game, where you play as Tosbik, a sea turtle who wants to clean the seas of the world from all the pollution. Thanks to its magical abilities, Tosbik can shoot magical starfish that turn polluting items into mini starfish and clean the seas! 

You can go on an adventure and clean the seas of the World, and then come back and try to beat your high score and make the sea you love even cleaner!


Who is this game for?

This is a game for people who are looking for the simple pleasure of being in the sea, enjoying the vast shades of blue, green and other colors, people who love to see fish swim around. It is also for people who want to start a game, pass their last level and feel good. 

We wanted this game to be a tribute to Flash games of the old, where several artists could come together and make a game that would be enjoyed by others, where a good core mechanic and numerous levels to be passed would be within reach of the player.
